method: breaths by loudness (under -21 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 14 of 15 breaks heard

lines.latin: Ubi cáritas et amor, Deus ibi est.
lines.english: Where charity and love are, God is there.

lines.latin: Congregávit nos in unum Christi amor.
lines.english: The love of Christ hath gathered us together into one.
Let us rejoice, and in Him be glad.
Let us fear and let us love the living God.

lines.latin: Et ex corde diligámus nos sincéro.
lines.english: And let us love one another with a sincere heart.

lines.latin: Ubi cáritas et amor, Deus ibi est.
lines.english: Where charity and love are, God is there.

lines.latin: Simul ergo cum in unum congregámur:
lines.english: When therefore we are gathered together into one,
let us beware lest we be divided in mind.
Let malicious quarrels cease, let strife cease.

lines.latin: Et in médio nostri sit Christus Deus.
lines.english: And in the midst of us be Christ our God.

lines.latin: Ubi cáritas et amor, Deus ibi est.
lines.english: Where charity and love are, God is there.
Together also with the blessed may we see
Thy face in glory, O Christ our God:

lines.latin: Gáudium, quod est imménsum, atque probum:
lines.english: a joy that is boundless and good,
unto the endless ages of ages.
